error.message: Option "--disclosure-type" must be an array of DART 공시상세유형 detailed codes, for example ["A001"](사업보고서), ["A002"](반기보고서), ["A003"](분기보고서), or ["I001"](수시공시). Use reportName for report-title text such as "사업보고서".
error.recoveryHint: Pass known DART 공시상세유형 detailed codes (A001=사업보고서, A002=반기보고서, A003=분기보고서, I001=수시공시, etc.) as an array. If you do not know the code, use the disclosure-types operation or darty disclosure-types --query <term>, and put report-title text in reportName.
